import sys,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import analyze as AN, stress_feas as SF
for seed in [100,101,102]:

    try:
        norm=AN.validate(req); res=AN.solve(norm)
        print(seed,'nobs',nobs,'time %.2f'%(time.time()-t),res.get('status'),res.get('min_faults'))
    except Exception as e:
        print(seed,'ERR',repr(e),'nobs',nobs)
